method: Preparatory review and local diagnostic tests only. Plan phase prerequisites not all satisfied. No production access, no workflow writes, no seed, no deploy, no application fix.

controls.result: Tracked dirty tree captured via git stash create without changing original working tree; detached worktree created; supplemental untracked test copied with matching blob hashes.

controls.command: env -i HOME=... PATH=... TMPDIR=... CI=true pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
controls.result: pnpm 11.21.0; 875 packages; 34.2 seconds; manifest and lockfile unchanged after Prisma generation.
Prisma Client 6.19.3 generated; no DB accessed.
Fresh isolated Docker PostgreSQL 17 lab, schoolpro-audit-20260907, localhost:51672, DB schoolpro_audit, 0 public tables. No demo database copy identified/restored; no RLS proof with this owner role.
Explicit local audit URL; host allowed; empty database allowed for first initialization. Does not establish integrity of an Ambouli dataset.
No demo dump or restoration verified. No business data written.

controls.environment: Node 24.18.0 macOS arm64; not production Node 22 Linux.

controls.caveat: Initial pnpm lint also encountered parent config/plugin conflict due nested audit directory. Explicit config isolation preserves all rules; not identical to Next lint wrapper.

controls.result: Les politiques RLS ne correspondent plus au schéma Prisma. campagne_reinscription and invitation_reinscription absent from versioned prisma/sql/rls/02-policies.sql.
No known vulnerabilities found; registry result at test time, not a complete security assessment.

controls.environment: Clean environment plus DATABASE_URL and DIRECT_URL pointing to dummy localhost port 1, not the lab or production.
controls.caveat: Two earlier clean-env runs without URLs failed to load 13 test files with PrismaClientConstructorValidationError; 1444 executed assertions passed but overall status was failure.
Extra diagnostic probe excluded; baseline was discovered before additional role probe file existed. These percentages do not cover all SchoolPro code.

controls.result: Baseline passed with dummy URLs, and again with coverage. Three identical successful runs were not performed.

controls.caveat: Local component tests in jsdom and API function tests with mocked sessions/cookies/rate limiter. Not gstack/browser E2E, no actual database data assertions.

findings.title: Versioned RLS policy coverage incomplete
findings.evidence_level: Static check executed plus source review
findings.impact: Isolation cannot be certified for re-enrollment tables from versioned artifacts.
findings.caveat: Actual production pg_policies and data access not inspected; no claim of a demonstrated production leak.

findings.title: Time Machine shows success after API rejects date change
findings.evidence_level: Reproduced on real component with mocked HTTP replies
findings.reproduction: Open modal, choose October 2025, apply. Reply to POST with JSON error and status 403, 429, or 500. toast.success(dateDesactivee) called, toast.error not called. Positive HTTP 200 control passed.

findings.title: Clock API state and server helper disagree for PARENT with existing demo cookie
findings.evidence_level: Reproduced in local function test with simulated PARENT session and cookies
findings.result: GET returns autorise=false enabled=false date=null; getDemoDate returns 2025-10-15T10:00:00.000Z from same mocked cookies.
findings.caveat: Browser login/role-switch behavior and resulting DB payload still need reproduction. Not proof of cross-tenant leakage.

findings.title: Existing E2E suite does not prove completion of several workflows
findings.result: Absence test never submits the call. Several suites only check screens, buttons, or accept empty state. Real writes and final business results remain unverified.

findings.title: ESLint validation fails with six errors
findings.caveat: Payment query already filters site through facture relation; cron intentionally spans tenants. Alerts require semantic review, not automatic classification as data leaks. Two errors are undefined @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any rule references.

findings.title: Unit tests depend on database URL variables even without DB queries
findings.result: 13 files fail initialization without URLs. Dummy URLs let all 1708 tests pass without a database service.

findings.title: Coverage constrained to eight files
findings.result: Coverage thresholds satisfied only within configured subset, excluding Time Machine and most business modules.

findings.title: Task due dates may use wall clock instead of demo clock
findings.result: echeanceDepuisRetard uses new Date(); divergence requires isolated workflow reproduction.

findings.title: Delay classification test duplicates implementation instead of importing it
findings.result: Nine passing tests do not prove the production classification function or its database inputs.

role_date_contract.expected: Only TENANT_ADMIN may set clock, other roles rejected with 403 and no Set-Cookie.
role_date_contract.timezone_note: Probe dates use explicit UTC. UI presets are datetime-local; timezone equivalence not validated.

not_executed: W-1 through W-15 end-to-end business workflows
next_gate: Do not certify dependent phases while RLS/lint and confirmed Time Machine defects remain open. Corrections are a separate explicitly approved task; restore an identified Ambouli copy before data-writing workflows.
